about.title: About
about.p1: I have worked as a Front-End Developer at Pardazeshgaran Sepehr in Tehran since July 2023, building and maintaining interfaces across 15+ healthcare, pharmacy, insurance and cybersecurity products, including Iran’s Ministry of Health telemedicine platform.
about.p2: My work includes reusable component architectures, state management, real-time data flows and role-based access control. I translate product requirements and Figma designs into responsive interfaces, and design UI/UX and build storefront and admin front ends.
about.p3: I hold a master’s degree in Computer Software Engineering; my thesis evaluated a smart-school agent-based architecture using ATAM and verified system behavior with CSP in PAT.

frontend.title: Front-End Developer
frontend.description: Built and maintained front ends across 15+ healthcare, pharmacy, insurance and cybersecurity products. Refactored legacy screens into shared component libraries and standardized design patterns, implemented role-based workflows for doctors, patients, pharmacists, SOC analysts, administrators and receptionists, and transformed Figma designs into responsive PWAs.

instructor.title: Robotics Instructor
instructor.description: Taught robotics and programming to students from elementary to high school in group classes and one-on-one sessions. Designed hands-on workshops with Arduino, mBlock, Scratch and basic electronics, and served as a judge at national robotics competitions held at the University of Tehran.
